patches.name: Dark mode
patches.description: Force dark mode for Amazon Shopping.

patches.name: Disable video autoplay
patches.description: Prevents videos from autoplaying in Amazon's in-app WebView pages.

patches.name: Hide Rufus tab
patches.description: Removes the Rufus AI assistant tab from Amazon's bottom navigation bar.

patches.name: Fix Amazon manifest conflicts
patches.description: Updates shared Amazon permissions so other Amazon apps can coexist.

patches.name: Disable search suggestions tracking
patches.description: Prevents search keypress and focus events from being sent with suggestion requests.

patches.name: Open links in browser
patches.description: Opens non-Amazon URLs in the default browser instead of the in-app WebView.

patches.name: Price history charts
patches.description: Injects Keepa and CamelCamelCamel price history charts on Amazon product pages.

patches.name: Remove ads
patches.description: Hides sponsored and ad content in Amazon Shopping via CSS injection.
